points.description: Sprinkler irrigation named as a type of irrigation.
Drip irrigation named as a type of irrigation.
Furrow method (furrow irrigation) named as a type of irrigation.
Flood method (flooding / flood irrigation) named as a type of irrigation.

rubric.notes: Each of the four listed methods earns 0.5 marks; clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. trickle for drip, flooding for flood, furrows for furrow). Add the marks and round to the nearest whole mark if the teacher marks 0, 1 or 2 (a total of 0.5 rounds up to 1 only if the class convention allows, otherwise 0). Wrong or unrelated items earn nothing but do not remove marks for correct items.
